summary: User Story SD-002 - Customer pharmacy/wholesaler license validation before order release
businessObject: Sales Order (with pharmaceutical customer license validation)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can create a Sales Order for a pharmaceutical customer.
The system checks the customer master record for the presence of a valid pharmacy/wholesaler license number and expiration date.
The system blocks release of the Sales Order if the license is missing, expired, or within a configurable warning period (e.g., 30 days before expiration).
The system displays a clear error message indicating the license validation failure and provides the license expiration date.
The user can override the block with appropriate authorization (e.g., for emergency/compassionate use orders).
The system logs all license validation checks and overrides for audit purposes.

HP.description: Create Sales Order for pharmaceutical customer with valid license (beyond warning period) and successfully release
Create Sales Order for pharmaceutical customer with valid license, release, verify audit log captures validation check

AP.description: Authorized user overrides license block (expired or warning period) with valid reason and successfully releases Sales Order
Sales Order release blocked due to warning period, authorized override performed, audit log captures override action and reason

NEG.description: Attempt to release Sales Order for customer with missing license number — system blocks release
Attempt to release Sales Order for customer with missing license expiration date — system blocks release
Attempt to release Sales Order for customer with expired license (expiration date < current date) — system blocks release
Attempt to release Sales Order for customer with license expiring within warning period (e.g., 15 days remaining, threshold = 30 days) — system blocks release
Unauthorized user attempts to override license block — system rejects override
Authorized user attempts override without providing override reason — system rejects or logs incomplete override

ERR.description: System displays error message for missing license number with expiration date placeholder
System displays error message for expired license with actual expiration date shown
System displays error message for license in warning period with expiration date and days remaining shown
Unauthorized override attempt displays authorization error message

EDGE.description: License expiration date = current date (boundary: expired on the day)
License expiration date = current date + warning threshold (boundary: first day of warning period)
License expiration date = current date + warning threshold + 1 day (boundary: last day before warning period)
Warning period configured as 0 days (only expired licenses blocked, no advance warning)
Warning period configured at maximum (e.g., 90 days)

input.name: customerId
input.label: Sold-to Party
input.validRange: Existing customer in SAP master with pharmaceutical classification

input.name: overrideReason
input.label: Override Reason / Comments
input.validRange: Free text explaining emergency/compassionate use (mandatory if override performed)

output.name: auditLogEntry
output.label: Audit Log Entry
output.format: Timestamp, User, Customer, License Status, Action (Released/Blocked/Overridden), Override Reason
